heroSummary: On EGUSD’s Traditional Calendar, the 2026–27 school year begins Thursday, August 13, 2026, and ends Thursday, May 27, 2027. Thanksgiving Break runs November 23–27, students are off December 21–January 4 for the winter recess period, and Spring Break runs March 15–19. EGUSD also uses Modified Traditional and Tracks A, B, C, and D, which have different dates.

calendarFaqs.q: When does EGUSD’s Traditional Calendar start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day on EGUSD’s Traditional Calendar is Thursday, August 13, 2026. Tracks B, C, and D begin July 15; Track A begins August 17; and Modified Traditional also begins August 13.

calendarFaqs.q: When is EGUSD Spring Break on the Traditional Calendar in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break on the Traditional Calendar runs March 15–19, 2027. Students return Monday, March 22. Modified Traditional has a longer March 15–26 break.

calendarFaqs.q: Does every EGUSD school follow the Traditional Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. EGUSD also uses Modified Traditional and Tracks A, B, C, and D. Check your school’s website, enrollment materials, or office communications to confirm the calendar assigned to your student.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day on EGUSD’s Traditional Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day on the Traditional Calendar is Thursday, May 27, 2027. Modified Traditional and Tracks A, B, and C end later.

calendarFaqs.q: Will the downloaded EGUSD calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The .ics file is a one-time import of the Traditional Calendar dates shown on this page. Later EGUSD revisions will not appear automatically.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 12, 2026 using EGUSD’s official calendar page, board-approved combined calendar, and separately published Traditional and track calendars.
sourceReviewDetails: Checked the Traditional Calendar’s first and last days, Thanksgiving Break, winter no-school period, Spring Break, student return dates, and district-observed holidays against the combined and separate Traditional calendar files.

The combined calendar labels Dec. 21–Jan. 4 as Traditional Winter Break. The separate Traditional Calendar labels Dec. 23–Jan. 1 as Winter Break, while also showing Dec. 21–22 as non-school days and Jan. 4 as an inservice day. This page documents both labels and records the full student no-school period.

Reviewed EGUSD’s separately published Modified Traditional and Track A, B, C, and D calendars to confirm their first and last days and to avoid presenting Traditional Calendar dates as districtwide dates.
The ICS file contains only the reviewed Traditional Calendar dates shown in the main date list and does not update automatically.
